project: Automatos AI Platform — PRD-227 Board Light-Up (Auto-as-Manager wave, chain 1/6)
description: Cut from origin/main — chain position 1/6 of the Auto-as-Manager wave (map: docs/PRDS/PRD-WAVE-AUTO-MANAGER.md, seeded on this branch with the spec docs/PRDS/PRD-227-BOARD-LIGHT-UP.md). SCOPE = three wiring diffs that make existing loops visible: (US-001) agent-side board handlers emit the same SSE events human moves already emit, and gain blocked/failed status parity; (US-002) mission lifecycle narrates into the launching chat thread via the existing PRD-205 background-message seam; (US-003) the notification bell can navigate approval_grant and watch link types plus a drift guard. BAKED DECISIONS (Gerard 2026-08-27, from PRD-227 §8 proposals): narration is ON for ALL missions — non-chat-launched runs narrate to the per-user Auto thread via the existing find_or_create_auto_chat fallback; MISSION_NARRATION_TASK_CAP default 8 (task-level lines suppressed above it; run-level lines always). ANCHORS (verified 2026-08-27 — RE-VERIFY by grep before relying): agent handler orchestrator/modules/tools/discovery/handlers_board_tasks.py:258-320 (allowed statuses ~:270, NO notify call); human path notifies at orchestrator/api/board_tasks.py:912-916, blocked handling :548-553 + :898-902; notify_board_event orchestrator/services/board_events.py:38-70 (fail-soft — a NOTIFY failure never fails the caller); coordinator seams orchestrator/services/coordinator_service.py:3129 (approve_plan) + :2272 (_record_task_result); messenger orchestrator/services/chat_messenger.py:96-202 (deliver_background_message is the fail-soft producer wrapper; today's ONLY producers are watch_notifications.py:87-100 and scheduled_task_service.py:446-465); bell frontend/components/notifications/notification-bell.tsx:42-64 linkFor; the two unlinked producers write link_type at orchestrator/modules/tools/execution/tool_grants.py:412 and orchestrator/services/watch_notifications.py:75. BINDING RULES: NO new alembic revisions (acceptance-enforced); NO new tables; NO new routes (route manifest untouched); NO new SSE event names (board_changed/chat_changed only — services/board_events.py:229-231); no os.getenv outside orchestrator/config.py (MISSION_NARRATION_TASK_CAP lives in config.py); NOTIFY/narration failures must be fail-soft (never fail the tool call or the coordinator tick); canonical terms (Mission, Task, Auto is a proper noun); PURE tests (@integration skips cleanly without local Postgres; real-Postgres is CI test.yml per-story push); NEVER 'git add -A'/'git add .'/'-u' (node_modules untracked and NOT gitignored — stage explicit paths only); never 'git stash -u'. Frontend gate: cd frontend && npm run -s test green after US-003.

userStories.title: Agent-side board moves push SSE + blocked/failed parity
userStories.description: In orchestrator/modules/tools/discovery/handlers_board_tasks.py: after every successful board write in the create/assign/update-status handlers, call notify_board_event with the same payload shape the human path uses (api/board_tasks.py:912-916 — re-verify the exact payload). Extend update_board_task_status's allowed statuses (~:270) with 'blocked' (REQUIRES a blocked_reason argument, sets blocked_at — mirror api/board_tasks.py:548-553) and 'failed', keeping transition validation identical to the HTTP path (:898-902). Import/notify must be fail-soft exactly like board_events.py:38-70 — a NOTIFY failure logs and continues, never raises into the tool call. Do NOT change the SSE frame vocabulary.

userStories.title: Mission lifecycle narrates into the launching thread
userStories.description: Add mission narration producers on the EXISTING PRD-205 seam (services/chat_messenger.py deliver_background_message — reuse, never a parallel path): (a) plan approved → running (coordinator_service.py:3129 approve_plan), (b) each task terminal state — one line per task (:2272 _record_task_result), (c) run terminal states (completed/failed/cancelled — find the run-terminal transition sites in coordinator_service.py by grep). Target = the mission's originating chat; capture origin_chat_id for missions the same server-injected way watches do (platform_executor.py:1111 pattern — re-verify how handlers_missions.py can carry it; if platform_create_mission's executor context already exposes the chat id, persist it on the run's config JSONB, rebuild-don't-mutate) and fall back to the per-user Auto thread (find_or_create_auto_chat) for wizard/scheduled runs. Throttle: task-level lines are SUPPRESSED when the run has more than MISSION_NARRATION_TASK_CAP tasks (new config.py constant, default 8, no os.getenv elsewhere); run-level lines always send. Source label 'Auto · mission' with link_type='mission', link_id=run id (the bell + badge already deep-link missions). All sends via deliver_background_message (fail-soft).
acceptanceCriteria: DONE — coordinator_service.py _narrate_mission/_narrate_run_terminal route through deliver_background_message (the sole PRD-205 seam) with source label 'Auto · mission' + link_type='mission' + link_id=run.id. Hooks: approve_plan (run_started), _record_task_result (task_completed/task_failed on settled state), the per-tick terminal observer (:1798) + cancel_mission + approval-expiry (completed/failed/cancelled). Tests: test_narrate_mission_targets_origin_chat, test_approve_plan_narrates_start, test_record_task_result_narrates_completed_task, test_narrate_run_terminal_texts[completed/failed/cancelled] — assert texts + targets.
